title: QueryEngine (all 6 CSVs, ~24k matches + 18k players) is rebuilt from disk on every tool/endpoint call
evidence: src/mcp_server.py:30 get_query_engine() returns a fresh QueryEngine() per call; QueryEngine.__init__ (src/data_utils.py:322) constructs DataLoader which reparses every CSV. src/api.py also does `engine = QueryEngine()` in each endpoint (api.py:64,101,126,...).
suggestion: Instantiate one module-level QueryEngine (or memoize DataLoader) and reuse it across calls.

title: find_matches_by_teams truncates to `limit` before applying the season/competition filter
evidence: src/mcp_server.py:76 calls engine.find_matches_by_teams(team1, team2, limit) which breaks at `limit` (data_utils.py:334-339), then lines 66-68 post-filter by season/competition on the already-truncated list — so a season/competition query on the two-team path can return fewer matches than exist.
suggestion: Filter by season/competition before applying the limit, or push those filters into the engine query.

title: No true date-range match filter — only whole-season/year filtering is supported
evidence: src/data_utils.py:352 find_matches_by_team filters only on `season`; no start/end date parameters exist despite match.datetime being parsed. R4 asks for 'date range and/or season' (season alone satisfies it, but the date-range half is absent).
suggestion: Add optional date_from/date_to parameters that filter on match.datetime.

title: Competition and standings filters use accent/case-exact string comparison
evidence: src/data_utils.py:494 get_competition_standings matches `m.competition.lower() == competition.lower()`; stored value is the accented 'Brasileirão', so a caller passing 'Brasileirao' (no accent) gets zero results.
suggestion: Normalize/strip accents on both sides, or accept common aliases.

title: Default entry point (src/main.py) launches the FastAPI app, not the MCP server
evidence: src/main.py:5,10 imports src.api.app and runs uvicorn; the MCP server has its own main() in src/mcp_server.py that must be invoked separately. R1 is still satisfied (MCP server + 12 registered tools exist), but the dual FastAPI/MCP surface is scope beyond the spec.
suggestion: Point the primary entry point at the MCP server, or document both.
